name: Zephr
tagline: The operating system for enterprise HVAC service fleets
positioning: Zephr connects dispatch, technicians, and equipment history into one system so multi-site facilities teams stop losing hours to paper work orders.

hero.h1: Every rooftop unit, every work order, one clear system
hero.sub: Zephr gives national facilities teams live visibility into HVAC service across every site — from the dispatch board to the technician standing on the roof with a torn maintenance log.

features.title: Unified equipment history
features.description: Every compressor, coil, and refrigerant charge logged against the asset — so a tech knows what failed last winter before they climb the ladder.

features.title: Live dispatch board
features.description: Route certified techs by skill, location, and SLA. Reassign in a tap when a chiller goes down at your busiest distribution center.

features.title: SLA and compliance tracking
features.description: EPA refrigerant logs, preventive-maintenance windows, and response-time SLAs tracked automatically across every location.

features.title: Usage that scales with you
features.description: Meter service volume in real time and see cost per site, per unit, and per technician in one exportable dashboard.

testimonials.quote: We manage HVAC for 340 grocery locations. Before Zephr our refrigerant compliance lived in three binders and a shared drive. Now an auditor request takes minutes, not a full week.
testimonials.name: Marisol Vega

testimonials.quote: The dispatch board paid for itself the first heat wave. We rerouted eleven emergency calls without a single missed SLA, and finance finally trusts the numbers.
testimonials.name: Derek Holloway

testimonials.quote: Our techs stopped carrying clipboards. Equipment history is on the phone at the unit, and first-time fix rate climbed nine points in a quarter.
testimonials.name: Priya Nadarajah

pricing.blurb: For single-region operators standardizing dispatch and asset records.
For multi-site fleets that need compliance and cost visibility at scale.
For national portfolios with custom SLAs and integration needs.

homepage.footerBlurb: Zephr is the field service platform built for the teams that keep enterprise buildings comfortable, compliant, and running.
